items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Yeah I never got a chance to meet Milt Hinton.

ctx.x: You know like I always think of Milt Hinton and guys like that.
Yeah I never got a chance to meet Milt Hinton.
Yeah. But those are the kind of people that you feel better after you hang out with them.
